module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter: a bit counter tracks valid serial bits shifted into an 8-bit shift register, then registers the byte with a one-cycle dout_valid pulse.

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit shifted into din_tmp.

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Qualifies serial bits; enables counting and shifting, else resets cnt.

anchors.name: din_tmp
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register assembling serial bits MSB first.

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Registered parallel byte loaded from din_tmp when cnt reaches 8.

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse accompanying dout_parallel when byte complete.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter gating shifts (<=7) and triggering output at 8.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: Counts valid serial bits, wraps after output cycle.

groups.name: deserializer
groups.description: Shifts valid serial bits into 8-bit register.

groups.name: output_stage
groups.description: Registers completed byte with valid pulse.
